away.name: Jacob Fowler
away.news: After a terrific start to the 2026-27 season, posting an impressive 1.54 GAA and .942 SV% in his first seven games (6-1-0), Fowler has been flirting with league averages since. In his last eight games (4-2-2), the 22-year-old American goalie has allowed four or more goals three times, posting a pedestrian 3.01 GAA and .897 SV%. The Canadiens enter Wednesday's game as slight +107 road underdogs against the Colorado Avalanche, who will welcome Cale Makar (lower body) back into their lineup from a two-week absence.

home.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
home.news: Scott Wedgewood is coming off a shutout, arguably his first strong performance of the season, but Colorado will return to Blackwood, who has been their go-to guy all season. The 29-year-old Blackwood allowed three goals on 28 shots (.893 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-1 loss to the Utah Mammoth, but he has been dependable on most nights. Blackwood has allowed three or fewer goals in 13 consecutive games (9-2-1), posting a solid .915 SV%. The Avalanche enter Wednesday's game as slight -115 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team they defeated 4-1 earlier this month.

away.name: Alex Nedeljkovic
away.news: Yaroslav Askarov has struggled to keep the puck out of his net lately, so the Sharks will turn to Nedeljkovic, who has been serviceable in recent games. The 30-year-old Nedeljkovic has won two straight games, saving 60 of 65 combined shots (.923 SV%). The Sharks enter Wednesday's game as +120 road underdogs against the Anaheim Ducks, who are without two of their most potent offensive players, Beckett Sennecke (upper body) and Leo Carlsson (upper body).

home.name: Laurent Brossoit
home.news: Brossoit had a successful stint with the Ducks earlier this month, but was surprisingly sent down to San Diego (AHL) after a 4-2 loss to the Nashville Predators on November 11th, when he allowed four goals on 22 shots (.818 SV%). The 33-year-old Brossoit was far from spectacular this season, allowing three or more goals in four of five games, but he made timely saves and posted a solid 4-1-0 record. The Ducks enter Wednesday's game as -133 home favourites against a San Jose Sharks team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Minnesota Wild.

away.name: Spencer Knight
away.news: Knight led the Blackhawks onto the ice for warmups.

home.name: Joey Daccord
home.news: In recent seasons, Daccord's strong play has made him the more reliable option in Seattle's crease, but the 2026-27 season has not been fruitful. That said, the 30-year-old Daccord was solid in Seattle's previous game, saving 24 of 26 shots (.923 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Anaheim Ducks. In four November games (2-1-0), Daccord has an ugly 3.64 GAA and .868 SV%. The Kraken enter Wednesday's game as -150 home favourites against the Chicago Blackhawks, who are 4-1-1 in their past six games.
